Drag to spin, or use the arrow keys. A small demo of the idea, made for this page. The real product viewer is on the live site.

The challenge

Present a premium product online in a way that feels close to seeing it in person, without slowing the store down.

What I did

Built an advanced Tallmade product showcase with scroll-triggered animations, responsive layouts, and an interactive 360° product viewer. The project combined front-end presentation and motion to create a more engaging way to explore the product.

The stack

  • Shopify
  • Liquid
  • JavaScript
  • CSS animation
  • 3D / 360° viewer
  • Parallax

The result

Launched a product page where visitors can rotate and explore Tallmade in 360°, backed by responsive layouts and scroll animations.
